title: How Often Should You Get a HydraFacial?
h1: How often should you get a HydraFacial?
desc: How often to get a HydraFacial for your skin type, the best timing before events, and what to do and avoid afterwards. Prices from AED 370 + VAT in Dubai.
answer: Most people get the best results from a HydraFacial every 4 weeks, matching the skin's renewal cycle. Oily or congested skin can benefit from every 2 to 3 weeks at first, while maintenance can stretch to every 6 weeks. Before an event, book it 1 to 3 days ahead.
body:
## After your HydraFacial

- Skip make-up for 6 hours if you can
- Avoid retinol, acids and scrubs for 48 hours
- No sauna, steam or intense exercise for 24 hours
- Use SPF 50 and a gentle moisturiser

## Getting more from each session

Choose the level for your goal: Silver for a refresh, Gold for acne and tone, Diamond for detox and ageing, Envoy for the full treatment. Add LED dome and mist (AED 90 + VAT) or oxygen therapy (AED 250 + VAT) for extra calm and glow.
faq: Can I get a HydraFacial every week?
It's usually not necessary; every 2 to 4 weeks is enough for most skin.
Will I break out after a HydraFacial?
It's uncommon. Occasional small spots can appear as congestion clears.
Which level should I choose first?
Silver or Gold, depending on your skin.
